headline: Reserve Bank of Australia Warns Inflation Outlook is Worse Ahead of Rate Decision
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia indicated that the inflation outlook has worsened, leaving the central bank uncertain ahead of its decision on its 4.60% cash rate.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets monetary policy for Australia to achieve price stability and full employment.

impacts.name: Australian Banking
impacts.why: A deteriorating inflation outlook increases the likelihood of interest rate adjustments, affecting borrowing costs and lending margins.
